findings.message: 第 4 节把 Theorem thm:zero 说成「解释了为什么只有这三个方向能竞争」，但 thm:zero 只覆盖「至少一个坐标为 0」的法向，对三个坐标都非零的法向没有给出任何结论，这句话的强度超过它引的证据。
findings.evidence: main.tex 第 185 行逐字：「the result of Theorem~\ref{thm:zero} explains why only these three directions can compete: for normals with a vanishing coordinate the area is an explicit decreasing function of $|a|^p+|b|^p$, so within that class the extremum is always at a coordinate vector or at the face diagonal, never in between.」而 thm:zero（main.tex 第 97–115 行；台账 stmt:000035）的前提是「at least one coordinate equal to 0」；三个坐标都非零的情形在本文里只有附录 A（行 218–224）的数值读数，正文第 4 节同一页自己也承认「the absence of a strictly interior maximizing direction is only verified numerically」（行 183）。同一节行 193 还把它列为 open problem (a)。

For normals whose three coordinates are all non-zero, the corresponding statement is at present only the numerical observation recorded above; Theorem~\ref{thm:zero} says nothing about that class.」原句「the result of Theorem~\ref{thm:zero} explains why only these three directions can compete」已不在正文里；同节 Limitations 段另写「the argument of Theorem~\ref{thm:zero} covers the normals with a vanishing coordinate, but no analytic argument is given for normals with three distinct non-zero coordinates」。强度已降到与 thm:zero（台账 stmt:000035，前提 at least one coordinate equal to 0）相称。此判为我逐句读本版正文所得。

findings.message: 第 4 节用一个从未定义过的「ordering cone $0\le a\le b\le c$」描述数值扫描的参数化（第 183 行、第 193 行、附录第 220 行），读者无从知道 a,b,c 指什么、凭什么可以假定这一顺序、两条边界弧 $(0,1,t)$ 与 $(1,1,t)$ 里的 t 又是什么——这三处都缺定义。
findings.evidence: 逐字引文（main.tex 第 183 行）：「by local refinement along the two boundary arcs of the ordering cone $0\le a\le b\le c$」；第 193 行「the critical points of $A_p$ on the ordering cone」；附录第 220 行「parametrised by the ordering cone $0\le a\le b\le c$ together with the two boundary arcs $(0,1,t)$ and $(1,1,t)$, $t\in[0,1]$」。第 2 节（Definitions and notation，第 30–54 行）只定义了 $B_p^3$、$A_p(n)$、$e_n(\psi)$、$\Sigma_3^{\pm}$、$u,v$，没有定义这个锥、也没有写出「由 $\Sigma_3^{\pm}$ 不变性可设法向各分量满足 $0\le a\le b\le c$」这一步约化；按我在正文里的通读，该词在正文首次出现即在第 4 节。
findings.resolution_note: [manual] 手工判词：H 自己读出来的发现（record_finding 落库） [H 复核] [round 2] H 显式复核 ⇒ fixed：本版 main.tex（sha256=e2c7a5277ef11a3b8af108945d903413b01a1e63cb62defcefc5462bbd670d8d）第 2 节 Definitions and notation（第 40–54 行）已补上定义，逐字引文：「the search for maximizing normals is carried out on the fundamental domain $\mathcal{C}=\{n=(a,b,c):0\le a\le b\le c\}$ of the ordering cone: every unit normal is carried into $\mathcal{C}$ by a signed permutation, and the vertices of $\mathcal{C}$ are the coordinate directions. We call $\alpha(t)=(0,1,t)/\sqrt{1+t^2}$ and $\beta(t)=(1,1,t)/\sqrt{2+t^2}$, $t\in[0,1]$, the two boundary arcs of $\mathcal{C}$; their endpoints are $\alpha(0)=\beta(0)=f$, $\beta(1)=d$ and $\alpha(t)\to e_3$ as $t\to\infty$.」a,b,c 的含义（法向的三坐标）、凭什么可假定 $0\le a\le b\le c$（$\Sigma_3^{\pm}$ 共 48 元、为 $B_p^3$ 的等距、$A_p$ 在其下不变）、两条边界弧的 t 及其端点含义均已写明；第 4 节第 183 行、附录 A 第 220 行引用的记号现在在第 2 节有定义，术语不再首次出现即使用。原文所述缺陷已消失。
